Younger voters remain Trump's weakest group. Among adults aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance while 70 percent disapprove.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 28 percent and disapproval at 63 percent.

Independents also remain firmly negative, with 29 percent approving and 62 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 64-to-30 margin, while men are somewhat more divided at 52 percent disapprove to 41 percent approve.
